items.title: Poppy Playtime
items.content_text: At Boulevard City, step into the eerie world of Poppy Playtime, where an abandoned toy factory hides sinister secrets. This immersive hide-and-seek horror challenge keeps you on edge as every shadow and corner could be a safe haven—or a trap. Combining suspense, mystery, and thrilling interactive gameplay, Poppy Playtime delivers one of most unforgettable and spine-tingling adventures. Book Now

items.title: Riyadh Season: BLVD City
items.content_text: Boulevard City is one of Riyadh Season’s most iconic entertainment hubs, offering a vibrant mix of attractions, from the dazzling dancing fountain to upscale dining, shopping, theaters, and immersive experiences for all ages. Visitors can explore OLULOU, where a towering dinosaur skeleton offers the perfect photo op, and let kids dive into four imaginative zones at PLAY-TOPIA. For thrill-seekers, Poppy Playtime delivers suspense inside an abandoned toy factory, A Lot Like Life challenges your bravery in a zombie outbreak, and The Conjuring opens October 15 with spine-chilling scenes from the haunted universe of Annabelle. Families can brave the haunted farm at Zeela House, while pop culture lovers enjoy FUNKO (from Nov 15), with giant figures and collectibles, and gamers embark on a real-world adventure inside MINECRAFT (also from Nov 15). Launching December 18, Flying Over Saudi offers a groundbreaking 5D flight experience that takes you on a 7-minute immersive ride above Saudi Arabia’s most iconic landmarks.

items.title: The Groves
items.content_text: The Groves offers a multi-sensory experience that transforms with each season. Every chapter brighter, richer, and more captivating than the last. From immersive dining concepts to live entertainment, art, and nature-inspired design, The Groves Chapter IV unveils new moments of wonder designed to excite, delight, and inspire.

items.title: Immersive Experience: Flying Over Saudi
items.content_text: “Flying Over Saudi” at Boulevard City, Riyadh offers a one-of-a-kind tourism and entertainment experience—the first of its kind in the Kingdom—inviting visitors into a fully immersive theater that engages all five senses through stunning visuals, surround sound, realistic motion, touch, and scent. Enjoy a 7-minute aerial tour that feels like flying, taking you across Saudi Arabia’s most breathtaking natural landscapes and iconic landmarks in an unforgettable, awe-inspiring journey through the Kingdom’s highlights. Book Tickets

items.title: Hayy Arts | Global Positioning System
items.content_text: Opening May 20, 2026, ‘Global Positioning System’ is an upcoming exhibition curated by Indranjan Banerjee and Lucas Morin. Global Positioning System is an exhibition dedicated to mapping and navigation systems. It tells stories of fast cars and slow trains, street barriers and trembling grounds, warping highways and broken bridges.

items.title: Hayy Arts | Red Wind, Coral Worlds
items.content_text: Opening May 20, 2026, ‘Red Wind, Coral Worlds’ is an upcoming exhibition curated by recipients of the Art Jameel Curatorial Open Call, Huda Tayob and Miriam Hillawi Abraham. Red Wind, Coral Worlds sites the Red Sea within an expanded and interconnected oceanic terrain. The exhibition traces the entangled worlds that converge across its waters, attending to the material and affective remnants left in the wake of centuries of movement and migration shaped by trade, pilgrimage, and displacement.

items.title: Hayy Learning | Recess: An After-School Programme for Teens
items.content_text: Recess is back — and applications are open! An alternative afterschool arts programme at Hayy Jameel for ambitious teens aged 14–17. Over 12 weekly sessions, participants dive into contemporary art through studio practice, research, field trips to local galleries and artist studios and mentorship from working creatives. Every student hand-binds their own portfolio throughout the programme, and the whole cohort comes together at the end for a real, student-led showcase.

items.title: Eishha (Live It) Fan Zone For FIFA World Cup 2026

items.title: Coca-Cola Fan Zone For FIFA World Cup 2026
items.content_text: The Diriyah Biennale Foundation, in partnership with Coca-Cola, presents the Coca-Cola Fan Zone at JAX District, offering football fans a vibrant public viewing experience of the FIFA World Cup 2026™. Hosted within JAX District’s iconic warehouses, the fan zone features large cinema-grade screens, dedicated viewing galleries, and coverage of Saudi Arabia’s matches alongside key global fixtures through to the final. Visitors can also enjoy e-gaming zones, interactive football challenges, family areas, and curated entertainment activities, creating an immersive destination where sport, culture, and community come together in Riyadh. items.title: Sikkat Al-Atimah (Street Food) Fan Zone – FIFA World Cup 2026
items.content_text: Sikkat Al-Atimah (Street Food) Fan Zone offers a unique FIFA World Cup 2026 viewing experience in the heart of Historic Riyadh, within the Qasr Al-Hukm District near Souq Al Zal. Combining the excitement of live matches with the charm of one of the city's most iconic heritage destinations, the fan zone features dedicated viewing areas, a giant screen, immersive audio-visual experiences, and family-friendly entertainment. Visitors can also enjoy a variety of food and beverage offerings, photo opportunities, and convenient access via Riyadh's public transport and metro network.

items.title: World Cup 2026 Fan Zone at Kimpton KAFD
items.content_text: Experience FIFA World Cup 2026 matches live at Kimpton KAFD, where a giant screen by the pool creates a vibrant atmosphere in the heart of KAFD. Guests can enjoy live match screenings alongside a selection of food and beverages, offering a distinctive setting to gather with friends and family and enjoy the excitement of the tournament. The experience extends beyond matchdays with lifestyle and hospitality programming designed to keep the summer football spirit alive, allowing guests to continue enjoying the atmosphere, entertainment, and social experiences throughout the season. Book Now

items.title: Solitaire Fan Zone – FIFA World Cup 2026
items.content_text: The Solitaire Fan Zone brings football fans together for an immersive FIFA World Cup 2026 viewing experience, featuring live match screenings in a stadium-inspired atmosphere. Visitors can enjoy a variety of entertainment activities, interactive challenges, and experiences throughout the tournament. The fan zone also features a diverse selection of brands across food and beverages, perfumes, fashion, and gaming, creating a vibrant destination for football enthusiasts, friends, and families alike. items.title: Coca-Cola Fan Zone at JAX District
items.content_text: JAX District in Diriyah will host the Coca-Cola Fan Zone from June 11 to July 19. The fan zone is a dedicated destination for football fans, bringing together live match screenings, entertainment activities, and interactive experiences in an atmosphere suitable for all ages. The venue gives visitors the opportunity to enjoy the excitement of the tournament beyond the stadiums, with spaces designed to make every match a shared experience filled with energy and support.

items.title: Ruh Space
items.content_text: Experience the FIFA World Cup 2026 at Ruh Space, a premium fan destination located in VIA Riyadh. Designed for football enthusiasts, the venue offers live match screenings in an upscale setting that combines the excitement of the tournament with exceptional hospitality. items.title: Summer Camp at the National Museum: Summer Wonders
items.content_text: Summer Wonders is the National Museum's summer program, offering interactive learning experiences for children and families through creative workshops, storytelling, games, hands-on activities, and live musical performances. The program encourages participants to explore history, culture, design, and technology through engaging activities that inspire creativity and discovery. Visitors can enjoy a variety of experiences, including family challenges, interactive exhibitions, craft workshops, shadow storytelling, educational games, and music evenings. Program Highlights Interactive family activities and storytelling experiences. Creative workshops for all ages. Educational games and hands-on learning. Musical performances every Friday. Interactive installations and museum exploration activities. Design, creativity, and technology experiences. Workshops Creative workshops are held every Thursday and Friday at The Studio, with multiple sessions available throughout the day. Activities are suitable for all ages. items.title: Jameel Library | Summer Reading Challenge
items.content_text: Jameel Library invites you to build a relationship with the library through curiosity, discovery, and spending time exploring its resources. This challenge celebrates the moments you spend here cultivating new interests and passions rather than the number of books you finish. Throughout July and August, participants will receive prizes based on the number of hours they spend at Jameel Library, turning every visit into a small seed planted among the shelves, and nurtured with every new visit.

items.title: Hayy Explorers | As Told by The Land: Traces & Memory
items.content_text: As Told by the Land is a three-month long thematic programme at Hayy Explorers for children aged 6–15 years old. Through educational programmes and artist interventions, it responds to the current Hayy Arts exhibitions by exploring themes of storytelling, movement, and shifting worlds. Across the three months, children are invited to follow paths, collect traces, and construct new worlds from their immediate surroundings and everyday life.

items.title: Esports World Cup
items.content_text: The Esports World Cup 2026 returns to Riyadh from 6 July to 23 August, delivering a summer-long celebration of elite competition and live entertainment as top clubs and players battle across multiple genres and platforms. With a lineup spanning tactical shooters, MOBAs, fighting games, strategy, racing, and even chess—including global favourites such as League of Legends, Counter-Strike 2, Fortnite, and Rocket League—the festival reinforces Riyadh’s role as a leading hub for international esports. New for 2026, Trackmania joins the programme, bringing high-precision racing where competitors chase the fastest times on one of esports’ most skill-intensive stages. The Esports World Cup, a multi-game global esports tournament and festival, will unite the global e-gaming community, including players, fans, game producers, and publishers, with a focus on fostering connections and collaborations.

items.title: Beaded plant Suncatcher
items.content_text: Sunlight has a way of bringing a space to life. As it passes through a window, it fills a room with color, movement, and small moments that make a house feel like home. In this workshop, participants create beaded plant sun catchers inspired by the light that streams through our windows and the natural elements we welcome into our homes. By combining colorful beads and delicate forms, each piece is designed to catch and reflect sunlight, creating shifting patterns of color and light. The result is a decorative artwork that celebrates the warmth of home through nature, color, and light.

Don't miss the chance of attending this parade with family and friends!

items.title: PFL MENA Fight Night
items.content_text: Riyadh is hosting PFL MENA Fight Week, bringing together some of the region's top mixed martial arts (MMA) athletes for an exciting week of competition and fan engagement. The main Professional Fighters League MENA Fight Night will take place on Friday, 10 July, at the Global Theater in Boulevard City. Fighters will share their preparations before completing the official weigh-in ahead of the tournament. Held under the Professional Fighters League (PFL) MENA, the event follows the league's signature "win-and-advance" format, providing Arab athletes with a pathway to compete for championship titles while supporting the growth of mixed martial arts across the Middle East and North Africa. Book Now

items.title: Ajeeb in Wonder House
items.content_text: A story-led experience that follows Ajeeb as he visits a series of unusual homes, each shaped by a different idea, form, or function. As the story unfolds, children observe how each space reflects a way of living, then shift into designing a home that suits Ajeeb himself. The activity combines storytelling with creative decision-making, moving from observation to design.

items.title: 1, 2, 3, A Little Space for Me
items.content_text: Small spaces can hold big discoveries. Designed for children under three with their parents, this environment is divided into three distinct zones: movement, hands-on exploration, and quiet play. Each area offers a different way to engage, from active motion to focused interaction and calm building. The experience supports early development through movement, touch, and shared exploration.

items.title: 1, 2, 3, Let's Rhyme!
items.content_text: Come sing along with us as we explore beloved nursery rhymes, discover new ones, and enjoy a wonderful storytelling experience. Connect with other families in a welcoming environment that promotes early childhood development and provides lots of entertainment. This session, lasting for 30 minutes, is ideal for children aged 0 to 3 years.

items.title: A Home I Imagine
items.content_text: A home can begin as an idea and take shape in many forms. In this workshop, imagination leads the design process. Through drawing, building, and assembling materials, children develop their own vision of a home and translate it into a tangible model. Each creation results in a constructed home that reflects personal ideas and vision.

items.title: Around the Table
items.content_text: An interactive activity where children explore how dining tables bring together different cultural practices. The program introduces a range of customs and habits from around the world, showing how the way people gather, sit, and share meals can differ from one place to another. Through simple role-play, children take part in everyday moments such as greeting others, welcoming guests, and spending time around a table.

items.title: Balloon Shapes Lab
items.content_text: Children twist and shape balloons into different forms, experimenting with how each movement changes the shape. Balloon Shapes Lab ضمن ترفيه وعائلات في الظهران. تبدأ الفعالية ١٠‏/٠٧‏/٢٠٢٦، ٤:٠٠ م وتنتهي ٢٥‏/٠٧‏/٢٠٢٦، ٩:٠٠ م حسب البيانات المتاحة. تتوفر لها صفحة جدول حي تساعد الزائر على متابعة الحالة والوقت أثناء الحضور. المصدر: Ithra Events.

items.title: Built by Nature
items.content_text: A bird’s nest, a termite mound, a shell, each one is carefully built, not by chance, but by need. In this workshop, children observe how living things design their homes, then borrow these ideas to sketch and shape their own. Openings for air, layers for protection, and smart use of materials begin to appear in their designs. What starts in nature slowly turns into a built form.

items.title: Children's Café
items.content_text: Step into the Children’s Café, a truly unique experience created just for your child! A space where little ones can enjoy their very own café moment, designed at their scale, where they choose, create and explore freely. From decorating their treats at the Art Toppings Station to relaxing in a cozy Reading Corner, every detail is made to spark joy and imagination. It’s more than a café... it’s a first-of-its-kind experience where children gain confidence in their creativity.

items.title: Hidden Home Bingo
items.content_text: A simple object at home might have a story that starts far beyond the room it sits in. In this fast-paced bingo challenge, children move through clues and questions, connecting everyday items to the materials behind them. As matches come together, unexpected links appearو turning familiar spaces into something to decode and discover.

items.title: Insightful Spaces
items.content_text: The way we experience a space is shaped by what we feel under our feet, not just what we see. In this sensory journey, children touch different carpeted surfaces, noticing textures, patterns, and subtle changes in sensation. As they explore, they begin to recognize how materials influence comfort, sound and perception in everyday spaces.

items.title: Interactive Exhibit
items.content_text: An open-ended interactive exhibition that invites children to explore, create, and play through hands-on experiences. It encourages curiosity, imagination, and discovery for children and their families.

items.title: Let’s Decorate!
items.content_text: Decorations change depending on the occasion, the place, and the people. At the Inspiration Spot, children get inspired to make different styles to celebrate.

items.title: Mic Moments
items.content_text: Everyday life is full of small details, routines, habits, and traditions that differ from one home to another. In this street mic–style activity, children respond to short, guided questions about their daily life. The format is open and conversational, allowing them to speak, listen, and hear different perspectives in a simple setup.

items.title: Mirror Or Window
items.content_text: Some images reflect what we already know, others reveal something new. In this interactive experience, artworks are explored as shifting viewpoints. Certain scenes echo familiar memories, while others introduce different ways of living and seeing the world. Through guided observation and creative response, children interpret what they see and translate it into visual expression. The experience results in personal interpretations shaped by both recognition and discovery.

items.title: My Family Bouquet
items.content_text: A bouquet grows, one flower at a time. In this hands-on workshop, children begin with simple shapes and watch them take form as each piece is rolled, combined, and built into a flower. Colors are chosen, details are added, and the process repeats, each new bloom adding to the whole. As the bouquet comes together, each flower stands for someone at home, gathered into one arrangement shaped through making and choice.

items.title: Our Place on Earth
items.content_text: A house in the desert is not built like one by the sea, and for good reason. In this experience, children explore how homes respond to their environments, from heat to movement to moisture. This leads into building and testing simple structures, adjusting them to stand against different conditions.

items.title: Painted Faces
items.content_text: What's a festival without facepainting? Children choose from a variety of designs and have them painted using safe, child-friendly colors.

items.title: Treasures in Every Home
items.content_text: Deep within the Earth, metal begins its journey, formed over time and transformed into materials we use every day at home. In this interactive workshop, children follow this journey, then reshape a simple tin container into a new functional object. The activity introduces how materials can be reused and redesigned for new purposes..

items.title: Where We Belong
items.content_text: Look closely at Earth, and it begins to feel like a system that never stops working; air moving, water cycling, living things adapting. In this program, children explore how life continues and changes across different environments, and how organisms adjust to survive over time. The journey then stretches further, looking at how science studies these systems and reimagines them beyond Earth. The experience connects life, environment, and possibility in one continuous story.

items.title: Who Lived Here?
items.content_text: Every landscape shapes the homes built within it. This treasure hunt in Rehlaat Gallery, children follow clues across three environments: desert, mountain, and coast. Each stop reveals a model home designed in response to its surroundings, from materials and structure to layout and function. As they move between locations, children match clues to the correct homes, discovering how climate, terrain, and daily life influence the way people build and live.

items.title: Zoom In
items.content_text: A tiny fragment holds the clue. In this Praise of the Artisan treasure hunt, children begin with a zoomed-in detail taken from a larger artwork, a pattern, texture, or small visual hint. Moving through the space, they search for the full piece, matching what they see up close with what appears on the walls. As the search unfolds, attention shifts to details that are often overlooked, building observation skills through careful looking. Each match reveals the complete artwork behind the fragment.

items.title: In the Home of…
items.content_text: Some homes are easy to recognize. Others leave clues behind. In this interactive library experience, children move through a series of spaces, each one arranged as a “home” shaped by a well-known literary character. Objects, layouts, and small details hint at who might live there. As they explore each corner, children follow prompts and challenges that guide them to observe, connect, and identify the character behind each space. The experience unfolds step by step, turning the library into a trail of clues where stories are discovered through place, detail, and interaction.

items.title: My Little Fort
items.content_text: Many children create small spaces of their own at home—under a table, behind cushions, or inside a blanket fort. In this hands-on activity, children build their own small “fort” using soft materials, shaping a space they can define and arrange. The session ends with a short story connected to the idea of shared spaces and home.

items.title: My Neighbor Totoro
items.content_text: A gentle and magical tale by Studio Ghibli that celebrates the innocence of childhood, the quiet beauty of nature, and the meaning of home found in family. Through the eyes of two sisters who move to the countryside, the story unfolds into a world of forest spirits and unseen friends.

items.title: On This Carpet
items.content_text: in Echoes of the Familiar Gallery, around every corner, a story unfolds. This workshop takes place on a carpet filled with familiar scenes, where everyday moments take shape through storytelling and creative exploration. Children move through these scenes, connecting details, building narratives, and expressing their ideas through drawing and simple story-making. Each visit brings together small moments into a larger picture, shaped by observation, memory, and imagination.

items.title: Sense the Home
items.content_text: A sensory space where children explore textures, sounds, and scents inspired by everyday life at home Sense the Home ضمن ترفيه وعائلات في الظهران. تبدأ الفعالية ١٠‏/٠٧‏/٢٠٢٦، ٥:٠٠ م وتنتهي ٢٥‏/٠٧‏/٢٠٢٦، ٩:٠٠ م حسب البيانات المتاحة. تتوفر لها صفحة جدول حي تساعد الزائر على متابعة الحالة والوقت أثناء الحضور. المصدر: Ithra Events.

items.title: Water Challenges
items.content_text: Summer is here and you know what that means… the water challenges are back! With all-new fun water-based challenges and activites, and a special surprise to end the day with! A set of outdoor water-based activities where children move between water games that include pouring, splashing, and balancing tasks.

items.title: The House of Ideas
items.content_text: We begin with a simple question: Where do ideas live? Like us, ideas need a place where they feel safe in a space that inspires them and gives them room to grow. In this experience, we explore the House of Ideas: where we will see how a thought begins, what nurtures it and how we can create spaces that allow it to flourish. By designing a pop-up house inside a notebook, participants build a small, personal world where their ideas can live and take shape. Through cutting, folding and creating, a quiet reflection unfolds: what helps our ideas grow, and where do they truly belong

items.title: House of Wonder
items.content_text: Wonder House is an interactive experience full of surprises and fun activities, taking children on a journey of discovery, imagination, and excitement.

items.title: Beast House
items.content_text: Your weekend is set at Beast House, Riyadh’s first music & creative members club. المصدر الرسمي: MDLBEAST. Beast House ضمن ترفيه وعائلات في الرياض. تبدأ الفعالية ١٠‏/٠٧‏/٢٠٢٦، ٩:٠٠ م وتنتهي ١١‏/٠٧‏/٢٠٢٦، ٣:٠٠ ص حسب البيانات المتاحة. تتوفر لها صفحة جدول حي تساعد الزائر على متابعة الحالة والوقت أثناء الحضور. المصدر: MDLBEAST Events.

items.title: Kindergarten Under the Palm Tree (English)
items.content_text: Produced by the King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture (Ithra), a new animated series makes its debut! Set in the diverse environments of Saudi Arabia, small animals embark on charming adventures, discovering the meaning of early emotions such as gratitude and joy in a warm world designed for young children.

items.title: Unbox Your Story
items.content_text: What if we combine reality with fantasy? How would that enrich your story? Join us for a fun family experience as you discover a new world of stories full with boundless imagination and possibilities. All you have to do is open the box in front of you to reveal the tools and materials within. Begin creating your characters and designing your plot with the various elements available to you. Unleash your creativity and share your new story with those around you!

items.title: Storyteller of the Day
items.content_text: Do you have the experience or desire to tell stories and would like to be a storyteller at the Ithra Library? Every Wednesday, you have the opportunity to read your favorite stories to the children, nudge them to love books, develop their passion for reading and stimulate their imagination.

items.title: Mishkat Summer Camp
items.content_text: Discover the exciting world of science, energy, and innovation at Mishkat Summer Camp 2026, where young learners can explore the future through hands-on experiments, interactive challenges, educational games, and collaborative activities designed to inspire curiosity, creativity, and teamwork. Organised by Mishkat Interactive Center, an initiative of the King Abdullah City for Atomic and Renewable Energy (K.A.CARE), the camp introduces participants to the future of energy while developing STEAM skills through experiential learning. Activities explore topics such as solar, wind, and nuclear energy, hydrogen technologies, the circular carbon economy, artificial intelligence, innovation, and programming, supporting Saudi Vision 2030's goals of building future-ready generations. The programme is free of charge and is open to children aged 10–12 years. Camp Schedule Girls: 12–23 July | Boys: 26 July–6 August | Days: Sunday–Thursday Register Now

items.title: Night at Ithra
items.content_text: An exclusive family experience for Ithra members. Imagine Ithra transformed into a living, breathing home, where footsteps soften and a new experience begins. “A Night at Ithra” is an immersive evening for families to explore a range of curated spaces across Ithra. The program moves through key locations including the Children’s Museum, library, theater, museum, and outdoor areas, with each stop offering a different activity or perspective. The evening concludes with a shared meal and an optional film screening. Designed for families with children aged 7 and above.

items.title: Nature's Architects
items.content_text: Nature builds without blueprints, yet every structure serves a clear purpose. The experience begins with a short film that reveals how living organisms design and construct their homes. This is followed by hands-on activities where children explore these ideas further, testing, building, and observing how form responds to need. The workshop connects observation with practical understanding.

items.title: niMú Adventures
items.content_text: In a world filled with imagination and wonder, niMú embarks on an unexpected journey among suitcases, dreams, and ordinary moments that transform into extraordinary stories. What begins as a simple moment of waiting soon becomes an adventure full of surprises, laughter, and discovery.

items.title: Virtual to Reality
items.content_text: What begins on a screen doesn’t have to stay there. In this experience, children explore a virtual space, then follow clear steps to bring part of it into the real world. Piece by piece, what was seen on screen becomes something they can build and hold in reality.

items.title: Finding Nemo
items.content_text: Everything changes when a father clownfish loses his son in a single moment, setting off on a journey across vast distances and endless dangers. Amid the ocean’s shifting waves, the search becomes a test that reveals the strength of family bonds that never break, no matter how far apart they are.

items.title: English Children Book Club (7-9)
items.content_text: Encourage your children to read books and discuss their insights at the monthly Children's Book Club meetings! Let them read and develop their linguistic, social and conversational skills.

items.title: Hayy Makers | Woodworking Course (Level 2) with Ahmad Sofi
items.content_text: An intermediate woodworking course focused on advancing technical skills through machine work, carving, joinery, design planning, and finishing techniques. Participants will gain the confidence to execute more complex projects with precision and craftsmanship. * Completion of the Foundations of Woodworking Course (Level 1) or equivalent prior woodworking experience is required. Learning Outcomes: Learn workshop safety protocols and proper use of personal protective equipment. Use Jigs and modify machine cuts.

items.title: Hayy Cinema | In Short: Film Programme — Summer Edition
items.content_text: In Short: Film Programme — Summer 2026 Edition This summer, Hayy Cinema invites audiences to discover In Short , a new programme dedicated to the art of short filmmaking. Running until August 6, the programme brings together three distinct slots: Our Stories: Bold works by emerging Gulf filmmakers and distinctive regional voices Borderless Intersections: A cclaimed international short films Across Generations: F amily-friendly adventures for younger audiences and the young at heart.

items.title: Kinusaiga Art
items.content_text: This workshop invites mothers and children to explore the meaning of home through texture, layering and memory. Using the contemporary fabric Japanese art of Kinusaiga, participants will create a fabric piece by choosing materials that feel familiar and comforting. The experience celebrates how home is felt through touch, emotion and personal expression.

items.title: English Children Book Club (10 - 12)
items.content_text: Are you ready to encourage your children to read books and discuss it at the monthly book club meetings? Let them read and develop their linguistic, social and conversational skills. we are waiting for you!

items.title: Summer Fruits Season in AlUla
items.content_text: Celebrate the richness of AlUla's summer harvest at the Al Manshiyah Farmers Market. This vibrant event features a range of locally grown fruit, including delicious mangoes, grapes and figs - highlighting AlUla's deep agricultural roots and cultural heritage.

items.title: Wrth Summer Art & Craft Program
items.content_text: Introduce your children to the richness of Saudi Arabia's traditional arts at the Wrth Summer Art & Craft Program 2026, organized by the Royal Institute of Traditional Arts (Wrth). Taking place at Riyadh Park from 16 to 18 July 2026, the program offers children aged 8–12 an enriching summer experience through a sensory, hands-on journey exploring the traditional arts of the Kingdom's diverse regions. Through a variety of interactive activity stations, children will discover heritage-inspired crafts including pottery, Al Sadu weaving, traditional incense burner (mabkharah) making, Najdi door decoration, and other traditional art forms. Designed to nurture creativity, develop practical skills, and deepen appreciation for Saudi culture, the program provides an engaging environment where young learners can explore, create, and connect with the Kingdom's rich artistic heritage. Book Now

items.title: Tales of the Night Sky (English)
items.content_text: This magical Mommy and Me experience invites families on a journey through the night sky, beginning with a storytime inspired by traditional Arab tales of the constellations. After the story, we will design constellation cards featuring their favorite star patterns, blending creativity with storytelling. The morning will end with a shared breakfast, offering a special moment to connect, reflect and enjoy quality time together.

items.title: The Magical Suitcase
items.content_text: A pair of clowns, Wachi and Pica, arrive in town with a giant suitcase, the biggest suitcase you have ever seen. It follows them wherever they go. Beneath this enormous suitcase, you can spot the legs and shoes of four other clowns, their friends. Follow them and discover who they are.

items.title: The Lorax
items.content_text: In a world where trees have disappeared, a young boy named Ted goes on a journey to discover a real tree. Along the way, he encounters the Lorax, a guardian who speaks on behalf of the trees. This leads to a journey that reveals the importance of protecting nature and caring for the environment.

items.title: Reading and the Child's Personality
items.content_text: A dialogue session that opens windows of thought, exploring how reading is a vital tool that creates awareness, enhances a child's personality, and develops thinking skills in young children, and transforms the child reader into a expressive and creative individual.

items.title: Sustainability in Children's Literature, Insights and Experiences
items.content_text: A panel discussion that presents inspiring insights and experiences to transform reading from a transient activity into a sustainable passion.

items.title: Meet with an Expert: Fatimah Sharafeddine
items.content_text: A meeting rich in dialogue and knowledge, where we meet with an expert specializing in children's literature to open windows of understanding in this vital field that shapes the awareness of future generations. This interactive session combines consultation and in-depth intellectual discussion, in which the expert answers questions and provides specialized insights on how to choose appropriate literature for children, the impact of reading on building a child's personality, and how to enhance their values and skills through the written word. The meeting targets the following groups: - Parents - Teachers and educators - Publishers and writers in children's literature

items.title: Painted Lamps
items.content_text: Light has a way of bringing a space to life. In this workshop, mothers and children transform simple lamps into personalized creations through painting and decoration. Inspired by the colors, patterns, and details that make a home feel familiar, participants design a glowing piece that is both decorative and functional, bringing a touch of warmth and creativity into their space.

items.title: Today's Story Narrator with Samar Barraj
items.content_text: An enjoyable reading session aimed at instilling a love of books in children and developing their passion for reading. items.content_text: This session addresses the journey of the children's book through publishing and translation, and discusses how stories, values, and ideas are conveyed to children across multiple languages and cultures. items.title: From Idea to Narrative: How We Write for Children's Hearts
items.content_text: The session explores the process of transforming an idea into engaging narratives for children, covering the key elements of building the story, including the narrator's voice, language and educational messages, and how these components can foster a love of reading in children.

items.title: Bringing the Text into Reading Environments
items.content_text: In this session, we discuss the journey of the text within diverse reading environments, including schools, libraries, digital platforms, and cultural spaces tailored for children. We also explore the factors that contribute to enhancing the presence of engaging texts for children.

items.title: A House Reads: A Story that Begins with the Family
items.content_text: An interactive workshop designed for children to discover the reading boosters that ignite their passion for books, and create a lifelong friendship with reading, making books their closest companions.

items.title: Summer Splash Running event
items.content_text: Summer Splash is a family-friendly running event taking place at ROSHN Front in Riyadh, featuring 2 km and 5 km run and walk categories. Organized by Race Arabia, the event combines fitness and entertainment with splash zones, water activities, and a lively community atmosphere, offering participants of all ages a unique summer running experience. Register Now

items.title: Hayy Makers | Introduction to Pottery Course with Pharah Al-Ghalib
items.content_text: This intensive three-day course with artist and designer Pharah Al-Ghalib offers a comprehensive introduction to wheel-thrown pottery, guiding participants through the full spectrum of the ceramic process. Day 1 Clay & Wheel Fundamentals: Focuses on understanding clay—its qualities, preparation, and potential. Participants will learn wedging techniques before moving to the wheel to practice centering, opening, and pulling walls, creating several forms to be set aside to dry to a leather-hard stage.

items.title: Spot of Inspiration
items.content_text: Step into our creative space and explore a wide variety of new artistic tools and techniques. Enjoy an inspiring interactive experience, featuring artistic showcases designed to spark children’s creativity and develop their artistic sense. Join us and discover what inspires you in a world full of colors, textures, and creative possibilities!

items.title: Children's Museum Story Time
items.content_text: Dive into the world of imagination with enchanting stories that will spark your creativity and transport you to new adventures!

items.title: Children's Art Studio
items.content_text: A space where children can explore their creativity and imagination, with colors, patterns, engage in art discussions with a Play Guide and much more!

items.title: Energy Lab
items.content_text: Join us in our Energy Lab, where your curious minds can expand and explore the wonders of scientific and engineering ideas! Here, you can conduct crazy experiments and share knowledge with like-minded friends.

items.title: أوركسترا Harry Potter
items.content_text: استمتع بأوركسترا ،Harry Potter عرض موسيقي حي يقدم الموسيقى التصويرية لسلسلة الأفام الشهيرة لعشاق السلسلة ومحبي الموسيقى السينمائية.

items.title: Arabic Children Book Club (10-12)
items.content_text: Are you ready to encourage your children to read books and discuss it at the monthly book club meetings? Let them read and develop their linguistic, social and conversational skills. we are waiting for you!

items.title: Family Challenges
items.content_text: This challenge sets you up for an entertaining quality time with your loved ones! Join us to engage in exciting trivia showdowns, thrilling challenges against other families, and create memorable memories with your little ones!

items.title: Trivia Night - Earth Quest: Tic-Tac-Know
items.content_text: Join us with your family and friends for trivia night at the Energy Exhibit, where you can play in friendly rounds and put your general knowledge to the test! Every journey starts with one step... A quick adventure through time, where ancient rocks tell the Earth's story in a deep, silent voice. Choose your card, accept the challenge and let the stones reveal their secrets.

items.title: Grand Art Space
items.content_text: The Grand Art Space a vibrant world of color and motion where children let their imaginations run wild through painting, play, and creative movement. A place where drawing is free, play is art, and laughter is shared. Each child gets to explore their own colors, express themselves, and create unique art with joy.”

items.title: Stories from Ithra's Library
items.content_text: Join us at Ithra’s Library with your family, where every Friday, we gather round and read a selection of gripping stories, work together to unravel the morals of each one of them, and discuss authors’ hidden meanings.

items.title: Family Game
items.content_text: Every month a new fun challenging and educational game for you and your family to play and spend unforgettable time together at Ithra library!

items.title: Toddler Saturday
items.content_text: Activities you can enjoy with your children aged three and younger and help develop their gross motors, fine motors and cognitive skills.

items.title: Workshop at the Library
items.content_text: Join us at the Ithra Library as we read a different story each time, enriching our imagination through it, followed by a workshop inspired by the tale to reinforce its values and deepen its meaning. You will also have the opportunity to use various materials and tools, repurposing them to create new shapes! Innovate and create with your friends and family, spending time full of knowledge, crafting unique pieces, and exploring fresh techniques.

items.title: Merath – Middle East Museums & Heritage Expo
items.content_text: Taking place at the Riyadh Front Exhibition & Convention Center, Merath – Middle East Museums & Heritage Expo is the Kingdom’s first dedicated trade event for museums, heritage, and cultural development. The three-day exhibition brings together more than 100 exhibiting companies and over 3,000 visitors, including museums, galleries, science centers, cultural institutions, government entities, private collectors, and heritage developers. Co-located with the Saudi Entertainment and Amusement Expo (SEA Expo) and the Saudi Light and Sound Expo (SLS Expo), Merath provides a strategic platform to connect with decision-makers and explore opportunities within Saudi Arabia’s rapidly expanding $67 billion heritage and museum market, reinforcing Riyadh’s role as a growing hub for cultural innovation and investment.

items.title: Saudi Entertainment and Amusement Expo
items.content_text: The Saudi Entertainment and Amusement (SEA) Expo, running for over 8 years in Riyadh, is the Kingdom’s premier platform for the global entertainment and attractions industry. Bringing together innovators, suppliers, and decision-makers from across the Middle East and Africa, the expo showcases the latest technologies and solutions shaping the future of leisure and attractions. More than just an exhibition, SEA Expo offers opportunities to connect with like-minded industry experts, foster collaboration, and take businesses to new heights in Saudi Arabia’s rapidly growing entertainment sector. items.title: Saudi International Falcons & Hunting Exhibition
items.content_text: The Saudi International Falcons and Hunting Exhibition is one of the largest events dedicated to falconry and hunting in Saudi and globally. It brings together everything related to falconry and outdoor excursions, from falcons and hunting tools to equipment and gear associated with hunting trips, all within a comprehensive space that allows visitors to explore this field in one place. The exhibition also features platforms showcasing a wide range of brands, alongside accompanying activities and events suitable for families, creating an experience that blends cultural and entertainment elements. The event plays an important role in preserving falconry heritage and raising awareness by offering content that introduces visitors to its history and significance within Saudi’s cultural identity.

items.title: Saudi Falcons Club Auction
items.content_text: The Saudi Falcons Club organizes an annual auction dedicated to locally caught falcons, known as “Al Tarh falcons,” which are captured during the hunting season. The auction is a structured platform that brings falconers together to showcase their falcons in a competitive live bidding environment, enabling reliable buying and selling. The event is broadcast on television channels and digital platforms. The club also provides integrated services for falcon owners, including transportation to the auction venue, along with facilities that organize and enhance the participation experience, all within a framework aimed at developing falcon auctions in Saudi. The auction also contributes to raising awareness about preserving falcon breeds by regulating sales and emphasizing the protection of endangered species.

items.content_text: Ultra Gobi AlUla marks the first international chapter of the legendary endurance series, bringing its two-decade legacy to the Kingdom's desert landscapes. Supported by world-class race infrastructure, this is a journey through endurance, history, and place.

items.title: AlUla Trail Race
items.content_text: Every January, AlUla bursts into action with the AlUla Trail Race - a dynamic celebration of endurance and unity set against its breathtaking ancient landscape. Whether you’re tackling the ultra-marathon or cheering on the Kids Run, each course challenges the spirit while weaving through awe-inspiring heritage sites and sandstone wonders. This multi-day event invites runners and supporters alike to come together, creating memories that blend athletic grit with cultural discovery. Expect vibrant energy, international camaraderie, and a festival-like atmosphere the whole family can enjoy.

items.title: AlUla Tour
items.content_text: AlUla Tour is a major fixture on the international cycling calendar, attracting the world’s top teams and riders for a multi-stage race through one of the most spectacular landscapes on Earth. From dramatic desert backdrops to iconic landmarks like Maraya and the Oasis, each stage delivers high performance and unforgettable scenery in equal measure. Individual AlUla Tour stages will be announced closer to the race date, but previous editions have seen riders traverse routes from Old Town to Harrat Uwayrid and Winter Park to Wirkah Mountain.
